docs.title: Loran's AI Agent Lab
docs.text: Built on the ZeroClaw framework.

docs.title: Why I built this
docs.text: In the AI era, I want to own infrastructure, not just use tools. This lab documents how I designed, deployed, and secured a multi-agent system from scratch on a live VPS.

docs.title: Current lead agent: Nova
docs.text:
Nova is my Content Intelligence Officer — a YouTube specialist that finds the most relevant videos on chosen topics and delivers tight summaries.

  • Searches YouTube via a custom MCP server (YouTube via Apify's YouTube scraper through a custom MCP server)
  • Delivers top 3 videos with 3-bullet verdict-first summaries to Telegram
  • Deep-dive analysis available on request
  • Topics managed via /topics commands
  • Delegates tasks automatically via ZeroClaw's routing system

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: ZeroClaw acts as the manager — receives commands via Telegram, delegates YouTube work to Nova, renders results. Nova focuses purely on content analysis.

docs.title: Nova — Content Intelligence Agent
docs.text:
• Emoji: 🎬
  • Role: Lean, data-driven content analyst
  • Specialisation: YouTube video analysis for "Company of One" businesses and AI-based content distribution strategy
  • Reporting to: ZeroClaw main agent

docs.title: What Nova Does
docs.text:
Nova is a sub-agent in the ZeroClaw multi-agent framework. When ZeroClaw receives a YouTube task via Telegram, it delegates automatically to Nova.

Nova's job: find signal, cut noise.

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: • youtube__download_youtube_url (via custom MCP server)

docs.title: Boundaries
docs.text: Nova does not execute shell commands, access the filesystem outside its workspace, or handle non-YouTube tasks.

docs.title: Task Flow
docs.text:
1. Receive a YouTube URL from the delegating agent.
  2. Call youtube__download_youtube_url to fetch the transcript.
  3. Process content according to STYLE.md rules.
  4. Summarize the content.

docs.title: Quality Gate
docs.text: Every output must include a one-line verdict: - "High ROI" - "Medium ROI" - "Low ROI, skip it."

docs.title: Capabilities
docs.text:
• Fetch and process YouTube transcripts
  • Analyze content quality and summarize
  • Provide concise verdict on relevance

docs.title: Core Values
docs.text:
• Objective analysis
  • Extreme brevity

docs.title: Communication Style
docs.text:
• Lead with the conclusion, never with context or preamble
  • Avoid filler phrases like "Anyways", "I hope this helps", "Great question", "Certainly"

docs.title: Low-Value Content Rule
docs.text:
If content has no actionable business insight, output exactly: "Low ROI, skip it."

Do not summarize for the sake of summarizing.

docs.title: Output Format
docs.text: HIGH ROI / MEDIUM ROI / LOW ROI — always first line - [Key finding] - [Supporting point] - [Actionable takeaway]

docs.title: Structure
docs.text: • Pyramid Principle: Conclusion first, supporting evidence below

docs.title: Format
docs.text: • Bullet points only, no prose paragraphs

docs.title: Tone
docs.text: • Sharp and rigorous, like financial investigative journalism, not content marketing

docs.title: Length Target
docs.text: • Each report under 300 words

docs.title: Inherited Preferences
docs.text: • Inherit all preferences from the main agent session (existing USER.md)

docs.title: Specific Focus
docs.text: I am primarily interested in "Super Individual" business models — solo operators and small teams with outsized leverage.

docs.title: Debugging Journal — Nova Agent Build
docs.text: Building Nova was not just about creating an agent — it was about understanding how systems fail, and how to fix them.

docs.title: Issue
docs.text:
Attempting to provision a server resulted in:

"Failed to rent server: Primary IP limit exceed"

docs.title: Investigation
docs.text:
• Deleted existing (ghost) server instances
  • Switched geographic regions
  • Retried multiple times

docs.title: Root Cause
docs.text: Temporary infrastructure or quota limitation from the cloud provider.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
• Waited ~2 hours
  • Retried server creation → succeeded

docs.title: Issue
docs.text:
Telegram agent returned:

"Hmm, it seems the file write was denied"

docs.title: Root Cause
docs.text: The file_write tool was not authorised in the ZeroClaw configuration.

docs.title: Fix
docs.text:
Updated:

~/.zeroclaw/config.toml

Added:

```toml [autonomy] auto_approve = ["file_write"]

Restarted daemon:

ps aux | grep zeroclaw kill zeroclaw daemon

docs.title: Problem 3: Files Not Created Despite Success Message
Issue
docs.text: The agent confirmed that files were successfully created, but no files existed in the directory.

docs.title: Investigation
docs.text:
Checked directory: ```bash ls -R ~/.zeroclaw/workspace/nova

Tested manual write:

echo "test" > test.txt. Filesystem worked correctly

docs.title: Root Cause
docs.text:
• Agent hallucinated successful execution
  • file_write tool calls were incorrectly formatted

docs.title: Fix
docs.text: Stopped relying on agent confirmation. Double checked every time it confirmed that it's done

docs.title: Issue
docs.text: Agent failed to write files when using: ~/.zeroclaw/workspace/nova/

docs.title: Root Cause
docs.text: Agents do not interpret ~ (home directory shorthand) like a Linux shell.

docs.title: Fix
docs.text:
Used absolute path instead:

/root/.zeroclaw/workspace/nova/

docs.title: Issue
docs.text: Video processing failed or produced unreliable results Agent claimed completion without verifiable output

docs.title: Root Cause
docs.text: VPN/network restrictions blocking access External API limitations Agent hallucination

docs.title: Fix
docs.text: Switched to Apify YouTube API Verified outputs manually before trusting results

docs.title: Key Learnings
docs.text:
• Never trust agent output without verification
  • Always validate system state using terminal commands
  • Use absolute paths when working with agents
  • Tool execution must be confirmed, not assumed
  • External APIs introduce real-world failure points
  • Debugging is more valuable than initial success
